stepBody: We have some centered design matrix $$X$$ with $$20$$ observations and $$3$$ features. The variance of the three features are $$125$$, $$20$$, and $$5$$ respectively. Suppose we use the SVD on $$X$$ to get $$ \cup , $$ $$\Sigma$$ and $$V**{T}.$$ Which of the following is the tightest possible lower bound for $$\sigma_1$$ (the largest singular value)?\nNote: For example, if $$x=5, $$ then $$x\geq4$$ is a tighter lower bound than $$x\geq0, $$ since $$4$$ is closer to $$5$$ than $$0$$ is.
